correctness.rationale: For all n>=2, tracefree symmetric A and real b, diagonal Gaussian cumulants give E F²=2tr A²+||b||² and E F⁴=3(E F²)²+48(tr A⁴+bᵀA²b). The zero-sum spectrum has sharp fourth-power bound ν_n=(n²-3n+3)/(n(n-1)) and maximum eigenvalue square bound β_n=(n-1)/n. The proof handles n=2,3 separately and excludes three-valued maximizers at n>=4 by constrained second variation; the remaining two-level patterns maximize at one outlier. A Rayleigh quotient bound and exact square completion in ρ=||b||²/(2tr A²) force the claimed constant and for n>=3 the positive linear/quadratic energy ratio (n-2)/(n-1)² with principal-direction alignment. I independently verified the rational scalar remainder for symbolic n and boundary cases; finite exact Gaussian checker is corroborative only.
